skill.descTemplate:
使用声骸技能，召唤幽翎火攻击，造成{0}的湮灭伤害，并附加{1}层[恐慌]。若目标[恐慌]层数不小于70层，则本次攻击改为附加30层[恐慌]。
目标后续受到伤害时，获得{2}层[恐慌]，每1秒最多触发1次。
[恐慌]达到100层后，对目标造成最大共振值100.00%的共振值伤害，使目标陷入瘫痪，期间目标受到伤害必定暴击，全属性伤害抗性降低{3}。触发效果后，移除[恐慌]。
目标瘫痪期间无法获得[恐慌]。
技能冷却：{4}秒

skill.descEnRank5:
Summon a Fae Ignis to attack, dealing 204.93% Havoc DMG and inflicting 10 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Panic on the target. If the target has 70 or more stacks of Panic, the attack deals the same DMG but inflicts 30 stacks of Panic instead.
When targets with Panic take DMG, they receive 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Panic. This effect is triggered once every second.
When the target receives 100 stacks of Panic, deal Vibration Strength DMG equal to 100.00% of the Max Vibration Strength and Immobilize the target. All Attribute DMG taken by the target under this effect is guaranteed to be Crit. DMG, and their DMG RES is reduced by 40.00%. Triggering this effect removes all stacks of Panic.
The target will not gain new stacks of Panic when Immobilized.
CD: 20s
